time.description: For set_edit_time: playhead time in seconds

includeCurves.description: For clip_dump: return the full curve/keyframe data instead of a track summary. Can be very large.

maxCurves.description: For clip_dump with includeCurves: maximum raw curves to return.

nodePath.description: For value_at_frame: path of the animated node relative to the animation root, e.g. "/Body/Arm"

propKey.description: For value_at_frame: animated property key, e.g. "position"

verbose.description: When true, lifts omitted caps to verbose ceilings unless maxDepth/maxNodes explicitly set

assetPath.description: db:// url or path, alternative to reference.id

isSubAsset.description: True if this asset is a sub-asset (e.g. sprite-frame inside a texture). Sourced from AssetInfo.isSubAsset.

containsSubAssets.description: True if this asset contains sub-assets.

limit.description: For tasks_info: maximum tasks to return.

spriteFrameUuid.description: Optional SpriteFrame asset uuid to assign

references.description: For select/unselect/update/hover: the items (hover = 0..1, null = hover-out)

selected.description: Currently selected uuids after the operation

lastSelectedType.description: Type of the last selected element

references.description: For focus: nodes to focus the camera on

size.description: For set_icon_gizmo_size: on-screen size of component icon gizmos

gizmoPivot.description: For set_gizmo_pivot: transform around the bounding-box center or the node pivot

gizmoCoordinate.description: For set_gizmo_coordinate: gizmo axes in node-local or world space

componentType.description: Exact component class, e.g. cc.Sprite, cc.Label.

reference.description: For material / serialized_material / render_pipeline / physics_material: the asset

effectName.description: For effect: the effect name as listed by the "effects" operation

entries.description: Array of 1-100 { reference, propertyPaths[], values[] } entries; each property array is capped at 100

references.description: For copy/cut: the nodes to copy/cut. For paste: the copied node references to paste.

keepWorldTransform.description: For paste: keep world transform of pasted nodes

pasteAsChild.description: For paste: paste as child of the target node

hierarchyPath.description: Path to the node in the scene hierarchy"

includeInternal.description: Whether to include internal engine components.

filter.description: Optional filter string to match component types or categories (case-insensitive substring match).

maxDepth.description: Max recursion depth. 0 = root only, 1 = root + direct children.

maxNodes.description: Max descendant nodes to walk; guards wide scenes where maxDepth alone does not bound.

verbose.description: When true, raises omitted caps to depth 99/nodes 10000.

fields.description: Optional: only keep these node keys per node (e.g. ["name","active","components"]). reference+children always kept. Omit for all fields.

siblingIndex.description: For move/copy: target index in parent children array

recursive.description: For lock/unlock: also apply to all descendants

references.description: For node/component: node/component uuids. For property: exactly one node-or-component uuid.

propertyPath.description: Path of the array property on the target, e.g. "sharedMaterials", "children", "myClips"

index.description: Index of the element to remove or move (0-based)
